attributes.body_ja:
「再（ふたた）び」は、同（おな）じことを繰（く）り返（かえ）すことを表（あらわ）す副詞（ふくし）です。「もう一回（いっかい）」や「また」と同（おな）じような意味（いみ）で使（つか）われます。「再（ふたた）び」は、文（ぶん）の始（はじ）まりに置（お）かれて、そのあとに繰（く）り返（かえ）される行動（こうどう）や出来事（できごと）が述（の）べられます。

「再（ふたた）び」には「二（に）回目（かいめ）」というニュアンスがあるので、何回（なんかい）も繰（く）り返（かえ）される行為（こうい）や出来事（できごと）には使（つか）われません。

注意点（ちゅういてん）

「再（ふたた）び」は「また」と違（ちが）ってかなりフォーマルな表現（ひょうげん）です。会話（かいわ）よりも文章（ぶんしょう）でよく使（つか）われます。
attributes.body:
再（ふたた）び is an adverb that means 'to repeat'. It is regularly translated as 'again', 'once more', or 'a second time'. Usually, 再（ふたた）び will appear at the beginning of a sentence, before some sort of request or statement will be made about what needs to be repeated.

Despite meaning 'to repeat', 再（ふたた）び specifically has the nuance of repeating something 'for the second time'. Because of this, it will not be used to highlight things that need to be repeated over and over again.

Caution

Unlike また, which is frequently used to express 'again', 再（ふたた）び is quite formal, and will be seen far more often in books/articles, than it will be spoken.

また and 再び both mean 'again', but differ in nuance and formality. また is common in speech and writing, used for repetition or to add information, like 'again' or 'additionally'. 再び is more formal and literary, often with a stronger sense of 'for the second time'.

attributes.body: Both 再び and 更に can involve repetition or continuation, but they differ in meaning. 再び means 'again' or 'once more', and is used when something is done a second time after a pause, e.g. '再び会う' ('to meet again'). 更に means 'further' or 'more', and emphasizes intensification or accumulation, e.g. '更に深まる' ('to deepen further').
